description: Feature showcase of coastal terrain v3 (AI 596) with its far-field surround: offshore establishing view, reef and bar, west bluff, beach and swim beach, terraced districts, the 80 m high city, the eroded hills, and a climb-out over the surround. Keys were placed from the D4 maps (hillshade, coastal zones, cover, drainage, elevation), the plan's districts.json and beach_points.json, and native ground transects of revision synthesis-7045f619de9de74a367bc3a8.
conventions: World X east, Y up, Z north, meters; sea level is the landscape manifest coordinates.seaLevel.
A key is {position, target, speed, feature}: the camera passes through position looking at target; speed (m/s) is the pace at that key.
feature names the caption shown from that key until the next key with another feature; null shows none.
Heading 0 deg = north (+Z), 90 deg = east (+X), clockwise; clearance is measured above max(ground, sea level).

features.title: Coastal terrain v3
features.caption: 4 × 4 km synthesized at 0.98 m (4 097² samples): an eroded coastal plain, a terraced city and a high plateau, with the sea at 0 m.

features.title: Reef and nearshore bar
features.caption: Reef rock 150–450 m off the bluff, tops 2–4 m below the surface; a sand bar at −2.2 m runs 110 m off the whole coast over a Dean-profile seabed.
features.mapHint: d4/v3/coastal-zones.png reef patches x 540–830 m, z 1300–3950 m; profiles-bathymetry.png

features.title: West bluff and platform
features.caption: An 11.6 m bluff face at 68° along 2.8 km of coast, its toe on a 30 m wave-cut platform at +0.6 m behind the beach berm.
features.mapHint: d4/v3/coastal-zones.png bluff crown/face/toe ~115 m inland of the waterline, z 1100–4000 m

features.title: Beach, berm and foredunes
features.caption: A 1:20 swash slope, a 1.8 m berm crest 31 m behind the waterline and 3.3 m foredunes where the plan leaves room.
features.mapHint: d4/v3/coastal-zones.png swash/berm/backshore/foredune on the south beach, z 0–1100 m

features.title: Swim beach and arrival plaza
features.caption: A sheltered swim zone on clean sand; the level arrival plaza (2.6 m) and the bus-stop reservation sit flush with the beach.
features.mapHint: beach_points.json arrival (1090, 490) and bus stop (1260, 520); district 7 Beach arrival

features.title: Terraced districts
features.caption: Each district pad holds its design band (old town 7 m, hillside homes 12 m, low city 18 m, airport 20 m, industrial 26 m), edged by 30° embankments.
features.mapHint: districts.json boundaries; d4/v3/cover.png urban ground, roads and runway

features.title: Eroded hills and drainage
features.caption: Fluvial and thermal erosion cut 65 drainage lines (3 m deep over 50 m or more) into the hills and filled alluvial floors and 1 080 flat basins.
features.mapHint: d4/v3/drainage.png gullies and flat/pond basins east and south-east of the low city

features.title: High city plateau
features.caption: The high city stands on an 80 m plateau ringed by 26.6 m escarpment faces at 59° over 33° talus; two graded ascents climb its flanks.
features.mapHint: d4/v3/elevation.png octagon centred (3480, 3100); roads.json High-city north/south ascent

features.title: Far-field surround
features.caption: Beyond the 4 km extent a render-only 32 × 32 km surround carries the land, the coast and its headlands to the horizon, with the 240–430 m ranges inland: no world edge.
features.mapHint: d5/surround/hillshade.png: coast and spur headlands to z ±16 km, ranges x 6–11 km east (seen from the hills segment)
